params.1274: Get some redberries (you can find some on bushes south of Varrock's south-east wall or grow your own with the Farming skill).
params.1275: To make a redberry pie, first combine water and flour into pastry dough.
params.1276: Use the dough with a pie dish to make a pie shell - Mess Sergeant Ramsey can sell you a pie dish and flour.
params.1277: Fill the pie shell with the redberries.
params.1278: Cook the pie on a range or stove.
